title: Abdali Retreats Toward the Foothills Under Sikh Pressure

blocks.text: Once he has crossed the plains, Abdali changes his line of retreat. After crossing Ropar, in the foothills did he wish to seek shelter, hoping broken terrain and guarded movement would spare him from the speed and reach of the Sikh horsemen.
The opposite happens. Day and night did the Singhs keep a vigil, shadowing the Afghan movement so closely that neither rest nor confidence can return to the retreating camp.

The harassment is relentless but disciplined. The Khalsa keep harassing them at night, strike at foragers and stragglers, and yet preserve moral distinction in battle, for Never would the Khalsa kill that defenceless Pathan who lay helpless and unable to fight.
